data.current_description:
Mêmes règles que l'export personnes : accepte `filters` ou une liste d'`ids`,
export **streamé** (un seul appel par `filters` jusqu'à la limite par export
du plan), plafonné par le plan. Au-delà de la limite, découper en segments.
data.description_suggestion: Exports an enriched CSV (70 columns: company identity, legal registry data, LinkedIn profile, Google My Business information, and presence flags) for companies matching filters or a list of IDs. Accepts the same filters as `/find` or a list of company IDs. Export is streamed (single call per filters up to plan limit with header `X-Export-Max-Rows`): no need to pre-collect IDs. For exports exceeding the plan limit, segment the search by criteria (department, NAF code, founding year, etc.) and export each segment separately. Export by IDs is useful for re-enrichment of previously collected lists or targeted selections. Each exported record costs 1 credit.
